reply.text:
I can't help with dosing on that one. Amounts for steroids or any other drugs are a doctor's call, not a coach's, and I won't put a number on it. If you're seriously considering it, sit down with a doctor who can run bloodwork and talk through the real risks with you.

On the training side, I'm glad to help. Most people are still leaving a lot on the table with programming, recovery and eating enough, and I can build you a block around your goals and see how far that takes you.
